import sys
import boto3
from awsglue.utils import getResolvedOptions
from pyspark.context import SparkContext
from awsglue.context import GlueContext
from awsglue.job import Job
from pyspark.sql.functions import col
from pyspark.sql.types import IntegerType, DoubleType

args = getResolvedOptions(sys.argv, ['JOB_NAME'])

sc = SparkContext()
glueContext = GlueContext(sc)
spark = glueContext.spark_session
job = Job(glueContext)
job.init(args['JOB_NAME'], args)

bucket = "propelnoi-vijay-datalake"
prefix = "raw/economic/worldbank/"
output_path = f"s3://{bucket}/processed/economic/worldbank/"

# Create S3 client
s3 = boto3.client("s3")

# List files in raw folder
response = s3.list_objects_v2(Bucket=bucket, Prefix=prefix)

files = [
    obj["Key"]
    for obj in response.get("Contents", [])
    if obj["Key"].endswith(".csv")
]

if not files:
    raise Exception("No World Bank raw files found")

# Pick latest file (files contain date in name so sorting works)
latest_file = sorted(files)[-1]

print(f"Processing latest file: {latest_file}")

input_path = f"s3://{bucket}/{latest_file}"

# Read only latest CSV
df = (
    spark.read
    .option("header", "true")
    .option("multiLine", "true")
    .csv(input_path)
)

# Select and rename columns
processed_df = (
    df.select(
        col("REF_AREA_LABEL").alias("country_name"),
        col("TIME_PERIOD").cast(IntegerType()).alias("year"),
        col("OBS_VALUE").cast(DoubleType()).alias("inflation_value"),
        col("INDICATOR").alias("indicator_code")
    )
    .filter(col("country_name").isNotNull())
    .filter(col("year").isNotNull())
    .filter(col("inflation_value").isNotNull())
    .filter(col("indicator_code") == "WB_WDI_FP_CPI_TOTL_ZG")
)

# Write processed parquet
processed_df.write.mode("overwrite").parquet(output_path)

job.commit()
